subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the shared `read` tool implement a small safe fallback for known binary document formats now, or should this issue wait for broader document parsing/provider-native file work?
rationale: Source inspection proves the token-waste path remains, but the issue offers fallback, parsing, and description-only directions with different security and product scope.

options.title: Ship Safe Fallback
options.body: Add bounded detection for known binary document formats in the current shared read path and return a clear unsupported-document message that points to dedicated document tools.

options.title: Defer To Document Input Work
options.body: Keep the issue open only as part of broader document extraction or provider-native file forwarding, accepting continued direct-read token waste until that lands.

options.title: Use Guidance Only
options.body: Update tool guidance without runtime blocking, which is lower risk but cannot prevent accidental binary reads.

recommendation.title: Ship Safe Fallback
recommendation.body: Add bounded detection for known binary document formats in the current shared read path and return a clear unsupported-document message that points to dedicated document tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The current read-tool boundary and most relevant read-wrapper history point to this owner as the best routing candidate for the product behavior choice.
